# Source

- Pack: Medieval Village MegaKit (Standard, free edition) by Quaternius
- Licence: CC0 1.0 (see LICENSE.txt)
- Downloaded: 2026-11-21 from https://quaternius.itch.io/medieval-village-megakit (Medieval Village MegaKit[Standard].zip)
- Files: the glTF files used by the game (spec 12.8), their .bin buffers and the textures they reference.
- Changes: textures downscaled to at most 1024 px (Lanczos). Normal maps taken from the pack's "Normals Godot-Unity" folder (OpenGL convention) under the glTF file names; the glTF folder's own normal maps use the DirectX convention.
